A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PSC and Latent-PSC research. Their main text, algorithms, equations, figures, and complete appendices are readable. All six original figures can be matched in v2.

before.justification: V1 reports original ImageNet compression experiments, MSCOCO Latent-PSC reconstructions, and image-specific rate-distortion results in Appendix B.

after.justification: V2 retains those original results and adds caption-source comparisons in Figure 6 and measurement-rank experiments in Appendix B and Figure 7.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1–2, adaptive PCA measurements, coordinated decoding, quantization, entropy coding, and the Latent-PSC procedure are retained. Caption inference was already an option in v1; v2 evaluates it and adds implementation pseudocode.

E1.justification: ImageNet256 and MSCOCO512 remain the evaluated datasets. Figure 6 extends the tested input conditions to automatically generated BLIP captions and absent captions, alongside human descriptions; v1 only reported examples using supplied descriptions.

E2.justification: The evaluated compression baselines remain JPEG, JPEG2000, BPG, and HiFiC. BLIP participates as the captioning component within the new Latent-PSC ablation.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix A change the reported ImageNet models from class-conditional to unconditional, removing the class-information overhead assumption. V2 also introduces caption controls and tests r = 6, 12, 24 with adjusted posterior-sample counts. Whether the retained experiments were rerun is unstated.

E4.justification: V2 adds direct tests of caption source and omission (Figure 6), plus measurement-rank sensitivity for both DDRM and PiGDM reconstruction (Figure 7). These substantially expand component and sensitivity analyses. V1's image-specific rate-distortion analysis is retained in v2 Appendix D.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental repeat counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Posterior draws and synchronized encoder/decoder seeds concern algorithm operation; the added experiments introduce no statistical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: New Figure 6 reports boat-example LPIPS values of 0.345, 0.309, and 0.350 for human, BLIP, and absent captions at 0.039 BPP. Figure 7 adds results showing marginal rank dependence. Existing Figures 2–5 and v1 Figure 6/v2 Figure 8 retain their results; no same-setting performance gain is established.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Equation 1, and PCA/posterior arguments are retained. The new appendices add empirical analysis and pseudocode without new formal assumptions, proofs, or derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the claims of training-free progressive compression, coordinated image-adaptive transforms, reconstruction-quality flexibility, and Latent-PSC applicability. The added experiments support existing contributions without redefining them.

C2.justification: V2 interprets the rank study as showing low sensitivity and recommends choosing r according to available hardware batch size (Appendix B). The existing VAE-decoding explanation and computational-cost, quantization, and linear-measurement limitations remain.

D1.justification: Appendix C adds a PyTorch-style implementation sketch, including a default sample-count rule and explicit float8_e4m3fn quantization. V2 removes v1's advertised code-availability link and instead promises complete code upon acceptance. This materially changes reproduction guidance, although the new decoder sketch contains undefined-image and measurement-indexing errors.

R1.justification: V2 adds Li et al. (2022), the BLIP paper, alongside the retained captioning references. The related-work discussion and positioning against previous diffusion-based compression approaches remain substantively unchanged.

P1.justification: Most main prose and the seven-section sequence remain intact. Changes include brief clarifications, paragraph splits, additional cross-references, and expanded appendix organization, with the original Appendix B becoming Appendix D.

P2.justification: V2 adopts a narrower text area, different typography, stacked author information, and review headers, rescaling and relocating existing figures throughout. It adds the caption-comparison and rank-sensitivity figures. Original graphical content is retained, including Figure 6 renumbered as Figure 8.

improvement.justification: The caption and rank studies strengthen empirical support. However, v2 replaces the advertised code link with a future-release promise and introduces decoder pseudocode with an undefined image reference and indexing inconsistent with Algorithm 2. The unexplained conditioning revision alongside unchanged plots also leaves experimental reporting unclear. These benefits and reproducibility drawbacks prevent a reliable net quality judgment.
